value.rationale: Sixteen canonical Watson–Crick 4-palindromes occur in genomic motif-avoidance research. Their complete circular local-avoidance period spectrum, primitive necklaces for all lengths, and exact symbolic constraint capacity are natural useful invariants. Factoring a 64-state determinant supplies an all-length structural closed form instead of an arbitrary finite census; the stronger SSA problem is explicitly excluded.
